text:
alex_m: Heads-up — starting a litmus sampling pass for the new q6b-int3 onboard. Need a micro-golden, dedupe sweep, and labeling schedule.
jia_w: size/shape? do we want traffic-prioritized or stratified by intent?
alex_m: Target micro-golden ~2k examples; include 300 hard edgecases (longctx, code, tables). Mix: 60% recent prod traffic, 30% synthetic anchors, 10% rare-intent uplift.
mika: For dedupe: use fingerprint sim threshold 0.92 for initial gating, then manual review on borderline set (~5k).
mika: Quick command to run the local dedupe job:
```
python infra/dedupe/run.py --input s3://redwood-curation/tmp/q6b-seed.ndjson --out s3://redwood-curation/processed/q6b-dedup.ndjson --sim-thresh 0.92 --keep-borderline 5000
```
curation-bot: seedset created: s3://redwood-curation/tmp/q6b-seed.ndjson (2.7k samples) — applied anonymize=false, provenance=traffic+anchors.
oliver_s: labeler capacity? also need tagging keys so we can filter for longctx/halluc tests.
luis_p: I can take the labeling rota. Capacity ~400 golden judgments/day if run standard batches. Will tag batches with `litmus-q6b-int3`. Can prioritize longctx/code buckets first. @oliver_s fyi.
jia_w: let's reserve a 10% holdout (canary) before any rollout. After 500 labeled golden we'll run the canary eval.
alex_m: Plan: dedupe job today, produce 2k micro-golden by tomorrow noon, start labeling Weds AM, run canary once 500 labeled (Weds EOD ideally). If regressions show up, rollback plan = fallback to fp16 model and run quick A/B.
mika: Add bench prompts for hallucination and code-exec edgecases. Also include token-length buckets: <256, 256-1024, >1024.
oliver_s: Will ensure labeling UI has the three tags + `litmus-q6b-int3`. I'll update the queue rules.
luis_p: minor request — include an extra 150 examples with adversarial paraphrases (we'll surface labeler disagreement more).
alex_m: Good call. Add 150 adv-paraphrase seeds from synth pipeline.
curation-bot: runbook checkpoint: dedupe job kicked (job id: dedupe-2026-04-12-81).
jia_w: Also add quant-litmus eval script: `tools/eval/quant_litmus.py --model q6b-int3 --gold s3://.../q6b-microgolden.ndjson --out reports/q6b-litmus.json`
alex_m: OK — final checklist: 1) dedupe (today) 2) micro-golden assemble (2k + 300 edge +150 adv) 3) labeler batches created & tagged 4) 500-labeled canary eval 5) rollout / rollback gate. Ping here when each step completes. :thumbsup:
oliver_s: ack :thumbsup:
mika: will drop the longctx bench set into the S3 path by EOD.
luis_p: tagging scheme confirmed. starting queue prep now.
alex_m: thanks team — syncing again after the first 500 labels.
